About Jeevan Jyotish

'Aapo Surya Bhavah'

In India, the study of astrology, or Jyotish Shastra, can be traced to the Vedic times. Glimpses of astrological traditions are visible in the ‘Atharva-Veda’, one of the most sacred texts of India. Vedic astrology is the interpretation of the arrangement of the planets as it applies to humans and other entities. We believe each of us is unique. Our analysis is different from textual astrology or prediction. The methods are proven and established by years of study. We make individuals self-reliant rather than dependent. Let's be a family to share, learn and grow.

A note on astrology

The awareness of what needs to be corrected only leads to its correction. And so, astrology came into being.

Meet Professor Jayant Mishra

Professor Jayant Mishra has been actively involved in helping people align their lives with their stars, so as to reap the full benefits of their being in this world. He holds an MS in Consciousness Studies and has twenty-one years of experience in Meditation, Astrology and related sciences. An expert practitioner of Kriya Yoga, he has also worked as a Reiki Grand Master (Healer), a Fengshui Consultant and Tarot Reader. He even helps his clients make great decisions in their lives using Rune casting.

Merely a conversation with him could help you receive immense motivation and a valuable piece of advice to make the most of your life. Contact him now to find answers to your queries and help solve the never-ending mysteries life throws at us.
